title: Harden HTTP Host authority and bind exact DNS answers to allowed endpoints

execution.environment: macOS arm64, Python 3.13, Linux arm64 Docker namespace, Core2 QEMU

checks.name: http_host_authority_pre_fix_counterexample
checks.detail: Invalid port and comma suffix previously returned 200 despite Host allowlist.

checks.name: http_host_authority_fix
checks.detail: Single Host header, numeric optional port and origin-form target pass; userinfo, comma/multi-colon, invalid port, duplicate Host and absolute-form are denied.

checks.name: exact_dns_answer_binding
checks.detail: Exact A/AAAA records and CNAME terminal answers must be covered by an allowed endpoint.

checks.name: ipv4_mapped_ipv6_dns
checks.detail: IPv4-mapped IPv6 DNS records are rejected before serving.

checks.name: controlled_dns_requires_endpoint
checks.detail: Device Service rejects controlled DNS without an explicit or implicit allowed endpoint.

checks.name: linux_namespace_lifecycle
checks.detail: One StickS3 guest completed WiFi, DHCP, DNS allow/NXDOMAIN, TLS 200/403, pcap and cleanup.

checks.name: core2_tool_hash_rebind
checks.detail: Two independent eight-instance 120-second batches passed against the new service and policy hashes.

notes: All network and Core2 results are virtual-device validation.
Physical cross-host scheduling, arbitrary NAT and external side-effect ownership remain OPEN.
Physical PSRAM/cache, bit-exact BT controller/RF and hardware remain NOT RUN.
